Snow: Adds snow to roads, sidewalks and paths, following the map's snow cover. Enabled by default. Turning this off hides the mod's effects.
Accumulated snow covers painted lines and arrows; they reappear as snow wears or melts. Enabled by default. Turning this off lets paint show through. Street names and tire tracks remain visible.

Higher values let traffic clear snow from traveled lanes faster. Fresh snowfall gradually fills the worn areas. Default: 70. At 0, broad lane wear is disabled; individual tire tracks and footprints still work.
Maximum in-game hours that small sidewalk and curb accumulations remain after the map loses its snow. Heat can melt them sooner. Default: 2 hours. At 0, they disappear with the map's snow.
Enabled by default. Uses the game's snow texture and color under the scene's lighting. Turn this off to unlock the custom RGB color picker.
Choose a snow tint with the color picker. Available when “Use the game's snow color” is off. Lighting still affects the result; this changes neither snow depth nor melting.
Adds small bumps through shading, using the game's snow normal map. Enabled by default. This affects surface detail; raised snowbanks are controlled separately.
Adds low, three-dimensional snowbanks near curbs and path edges, following accumulation and melting. Cosmetic only, with no collisions. Enabled by default; junction interiors currently have no banks.

Controls how far nearby snowbanks are drawn and their mesh detail. Balanced is the default. Low reduces graphics work; High shows more detail farther away. Available when raised snowbanks are enabled.

Limits the amount of nearby tire and footprint detail drawn at once. Default: 64. Increase if marks are missing in busy areas; a higher budget can cost performance. This does not control track darkness.
Replaces the normal appearance with estimated visual depth: blue 0–5 mm, green 5–15 mm, yellow 15–30 mm, red 30–80 mm. Does not change the snow. Turn off to restore its normal appearance.
Fine adjustment for snow that flickers or sinks into pavement. Default: 2 cm. Increase only if needed; excessive values can make the snow appear to float.
Runs a temporary visual test without changing the map's weather. Switches off automatically after 30 seconds. Leave off when checking real accumulation and melting.
With a city loaded, writes weather, rendering and performance details to ModsData/RoadSnow/rendering-diagnostic.txt. Use when reporting a problem. The file stays on your PC.

Adds displaced snow rims around impressions and banks between worn lanes. Wheels deform these banks. Detail is limited to the camera surroundings with a fixed geometry budget; disable to reduce GPU work. Experimental: may contain bugs and reduce performance. You can turn realistic mode off at any time in the settings.
Experimental: may contain bugs and reduce performance. You can turn realistic mode off at any time in the settings.
Lets snowplows clear the mod's road snow and leave piles along the curb. Turn off to stop new clearing. Previously cleared sections recover with snowfall.

Performance improvements for busy cities. Snowplows now clear entire road sections and junctions while preserving snow on sidewalks and curbs. Fresh snowfall gradually covers cleared roads again. You can turn snowplow clearing off in Snow → General.
